scope: Evidence, consistency, completeness and illustrative arithmetic review of the planning pack. This is not confirmation of a qualified company, clinician, bid, policy, live software or legally cleared operation.

findings.finding: The initial bid matrix summarized satisfactory performance from page 4, but did not preserve page 7's explicit no-record-of-unsatisfactory-performance minimum.
findings.required_change: State the page-7 minimum explicitly as an unverified company responsibility requirement. Require truthful history and buyer clarification for a new entity; selected positive references do not by themselves establish compliance.
findings.locator: RFP PDF page 7, Minimum Provider Requirements
findings.disposition: Verified EBR36 and eligibility.organization explicitly preserve page-7 no-unsatisfactory-performance minimum, truthful full relevant history and unresolved new-entity evidence. EBQ02 asks buyer how new-entity evidence is evaluated.

findings.finding: The insurance workstream identifies the two-year post-work coverage obligation, but the original economics model did not explicitly identify its unpriced continuation/extended-reporting cost outside the first-year premium and startup funding calculation.
findings.required_change: Add an explicit unpriced post-work cost/exclusion and pricing/closure reserve gate. Do not imply the annual placeholder or startup cash target funds the full contract lifecycle.
findings.locator: RFP PDF pages 5, 8-9, Errors and Omissions Insurance; economics scope and pricing gates
findings.disposition: Verified economics.scope.excludes, ECO-U01 and ECO-G07 explicitly exclude and require a separately funded, broker-priced two-year post-work E&O continuation/reporting solution. First-year cash/contingency are not claimed to fund it.

findings.topic: Technology setup effort and cost reconciliation
findings.finding: The model includes $2,500 for configured tools while the product plan estimates 38-76 staff-hours. At the model's base $65/hour operator cost, the effort range is $2,470-$4,940; the initial allowance only covers its lower end.
findings.required_change: Explicitly reconcile the effort range to the cost allowance, show the higher-effort funding effect or state the unfunded gap, and keep subscriptions/provider setup separate. This is a planning estimate, not a quote or committed delivery schedule.
findings.locator: products.json budget_and_effort_note; economics.json technology_configuration_setup and admin_loaded_rate
findings.disposition: Verified setup_labor_basis and changed inputs: 76h × $65 = $4,940 base/conservative; 76h × $75 = $5,700 stress. Recalculated one-clinician startup targets $74,223.05 / $101,350.91 / $137,013.58. All 378 numeric assertions pass after the change.

findings.finding: The initial operating screening description focused on workers while RFP page 15 also makes a representation about the bidder entity itself.
findings.required_change: Require evidence to substantiate the company exclusion/ineligibility representation before signature. Preserve the separate express monthly employee/subcontractor checks; do not invent a monthly company-check mandate.
findings.locator: RFP PDF page 15, first paragraph and monthly-check paragraph
findings.disposition: Verified EBR37 and EBF07 require bidder/entity and employee/contractor exclusion/ineligibility evidence before initial representation. EBR24 retains monthly employee/subcontractor checks; no monthly entity mandate is invented.

checks.evidence: RFP pages 1-3 and 6 support electronic BidNet submission October 30, 2026 at noon local time, questions October 27 at noon; October Eastern time is EDT. Public addendum warns only the purchasing channel is available before award. Portal fields and later addenda remain unchecked gates.

RFP pages 10-17 support bid-time COI, insurance representative and bidder acknowledgments, signed declarations, three notarized forms and W-9. No fabricated forms, signatures, eligibility or receipt are claimed.
RFP page 6 visually inspected: invoice and attendance must be received within 30 calendar days of service. Pack correctly avoids a net-30 promise and separates receipt, approval and cash.

Direct page-5 CGL, E&O and statutory requirements are distinct from sample auto/excess/per-project provisions and the optional bond. Conflicting insurer/cancellation/sample language remains a buyer clarification. ACORD does not replace WCB proof.

Independently opened NYSED dual-credential matrix and Education Law 8208. Official NYSED indexed pages confirm second updated child-abuse workshop November 17, 2026 and October 1, 2026 fingerprint fee $107.50. Earlier pre-contact completion is clearly a pilot policy, not an invented statutory date.

W-2 model is a proposed baseline, not supplied company evidence. Backup requires a real qualified person, costed availability and district acceptance. Clinical authority stays with licensed humans and district IEP owners; no guaranteed volume is inferred.

District platform/API and data permission remain unknown. The plan keeps clinical records, actual work, billable units and payroll distinct; agents cannot make hiring/clinical decisions, certify credentials, submit bids or release money independently.
All source_ids in the six input files resolved at inspection. Four prior-design source records in products.json explicitly name their provenance; every referenced prior record ID exists.

Executed check_economics.py: 9 scenario/scale cases, 12 sensitivity cases and 378 numeric assertions passed. Independently inspected formulas, insurance cash/P&L separation, owner financing, paid/billable units and conservative no-collection reserve. Source wages are contextual, not input market quotes.

User-confirmed new-company baseline is reflected in launch-core: no confirmed therapists or insurance, explicit not-bid-ready status and mandatory evidence outstanding. No outreach, procurement, hiring, insurance purchase or bid is represented as completed or authorized by this plan.

Compared all six assembled modules with current inputs and inspected rendered DOM text/source: new-company/no-confirmed-clinician-or-insurance baseline, 37 bid requirements, corrected responsibility gates, $74,223.05 base funding, unpriced excluded post-work reserve and 76h configuration cost are present. check_report.cjs passed structural links, record coverage, filters, all nine calculator scenario/scale cases and invalid-input controls. This is source/in-memory DOM inspection, not a browser-render screenshot or live system test.

limits: Review is bounded to the reviewed public sources and proposed plan as of October 20, 2026; current addenda and private portal fields require a final authorized check.
No company, clinician, insurer quote, official clearance, assigned work, fee schedule, payment history or district systems access has been independently established.
Passing model checks verifies arithmetic under assumptions, not a profitable or financeable pilot.
Generated HTML/source and in-memory DOM/calculator checks were reviewed; no rendered-browser inspection, live integration or operational acceptance test is claimed.
conclusion: Pass for the research-backed proposed pilot plan and illustrative model. All four review findings were corrected and verified. The user-confirmed new company remains not bid-ready; no individual, policy, company registration, price, order or live system is established by this review.
